avg payload: 420 tokens
peak QPS: 28
session types: summarization (60%), QA (25%), embeddings (15%)

jamal_se: I'll own the checklist. Proposed timeline: discovery call (this week), enablement workshop (next Tues), pilot Dedicated cutover (3 weeks). Anyone oppose?
